Getting Grimy in The Horror Bin... Night Shift!

games.description: A solo escape room inside a coffin, balancing dwindling light and oxygen against anxiety. After a failed attempt, the randomized locks, hidden switches and improvised tools finally lead out of the box.
games.title: Buried

games.description: Two solo visits to Jack’s crypt and cemetery. The first stops at the toolshed lock; the return solves the remaining graveyard and house puzzles, confronts the captor and rescues Hannah.
games.title: Buried Alive: Breathless Rescue

games.description: Two solo visits to the obsessive fan’s island. The first stalls at the missing number puzzle; the patched return reaches the boat escape and ending, then tests the president’s promised nuclear countdown without an explosion.
games.title: I Love You Freddy

games.description: Sark searches a dark school for notes while a fast glowing creature cuts through the halls. Deaths and repeated searches expose the maze’s confusing layout, and he stops without escaping.
games.title: Paranox

games.description: Sark explores a mansion, follows the Spinners family history and works through its escape-room puzzles. The final tape and police account bring the investigation to its conclusion.
games.title: Silence Channel

games.description: Sark explores the branching FMV story of a mall infested with giant spiders. He revisits choices involving Moose, Mick, guards and a secret laboratory, finding several deaths and alternate routes.
games.title: Spider Mall!
